stem: What is the best paraphrase of these stage directions?
instruction:
Read the stage directions from line 3.

[He unrolls the poster board. He takes a marker out of his backpack and begins scribbling. He talks to himself as he writes.]

options.label: A
options.text: Ben unrolls the poster board and finds a marker. He begins to write carefully while thinking.

options.label: B
options.text: After unrolling his poster board, Ben removes a marker from his backpack. He starts writing quickly while speaking to himself.

options.label: C
options.text: Ben quickly opens the poster board and begins to write information. He then shares his ideas out loud.

options.label: D
options.text: Once he finds a marker in his backpack, Ben opens his poster board. He then starts to jot down notes about what he is saying out loud.

visual_elements: [He unrolls the poster board. He takes a marker out of his backpack and begins scribbling. He talks to himself as he writes.]
